text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I join T.M. Opera O for the rehearsal for her New Year's performance, which will be held at her parents' house.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: La la la! ♪Oh? Who do we have here?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well met, Ayabe. I see my siren song has lured you here! What say you to watching the rehearsal for my New Year's performance?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? No.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh, she's merely trying not to seem overeager. After all, it's not every day one can watch a performance exclusive to family members!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! What a glorious day! It's naught but clear skies for this year's performance, and the entire world is my stage!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap! I've been so excited for this! Oh, and you're using the props I made!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Your design skills are as splendid as ever! Take that rose, for example—one would hardly think it's origami.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then, it's almost showtime, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Sorry I'm late, dear! I got held up at work! Who would've thought the grocery store would be so busy on New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Father
text_block_list.text: There were crowds everywhere. It's a good thing I decided to drive over and pick you up. Oh, we got some New Year's dishes and amazake as well.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mother, Father… You're right on time! Now, let's raise the curtains on this year's extra special New Year's home performance! I call it Dawn of the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Laaa la la la la laaa! ♪ The Overlord cometh! The Overlord goeth! ♪ The new year is here! ♪

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Father
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! What a great opening number! Watching this performance always motivates me to give it my all each year!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! The new year hasn't really begun until we've seen Opera O's New Year's performance, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …What a carefree lot.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: They certainly are!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Everyone's so warm, loving, overflowing with kindness… On top of that, the depth and breadth of their knowledge of the arts is vast…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Are they not a truly magnificent family? Their love nurtured and shaped the Overlord. It is thanks to them I can bathe the world in light…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Putting on this home performance is my way of expressing my love and appreciation for them.
choice_data_list: It's clear how much you love your family.
It's clear how much you love your family.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis! It's me! Have you finished packing? Are you going to make it back home in time?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Set your heart at ease, my beloved little sister! All is well. Actually, you've caught me at the perfect time. I was extolling your virtues to my friends!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Behold! This here is my trainer. Go ahead! Express your salutations!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And this aloof Umamusume is Admire Vega! Hehe! She's a dear and bosom friend of mine!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Says who?!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Oooh, so they're your friends?! Nice to meet you both! Thanks for keeping Opera O out of trouble!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Uhhh… Well… Sure…

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, well, I'll get out of your hair. I'm really looking forward to your performance this year!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that just now?! Ayabe said "sure"!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am moved beyond words right now! To think your earnest feelings would overcome your shyness…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey, I was put on the spot…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Whatever…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Go out there and break a leg… for your sister.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe! You bashful little thing, you. I accept your encouragement with open arms!
